Overview

What Is Odoo for Facility Management?

Odoo for Facility Management is an all-in-one ERP system built to manage every aspect of a facilities business — from maintenance requests and asset tracking to work orders, field service dispatch, and real-time cost reporting — inside a single connected platform.

Whether you manage commercial towers, residential complexes, industrial sites, or mixed-use developments, Odoo for Facility Management replaces fragmented spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one intelligent system that gives your operations team full visibility and control in real time.

At Etriplesoft, our Odoo implementation service for facility management companies is designed around how facilities businesses actually operate. We configure every module — maintenance, asset management, helpdesk, and field service — to match your exact workflows, compliance requirements, and reporting needs across UAE, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia.

Request a Free Demo → 🔧Maintenance Management

Corrective and preventive maintenance scheduling with real-time work order tracking across all buildings.

⚙️Asset Management

Full asset register with service history, warranty tracking, and depreciation across every site.

👷Field Service

Dispatch technicians with mobile job completion, GPS tracking, and real-time status reporting.

🎫Helpdesk & SLA

Centralise all client and tenant requests with SLA timers, escalation rules, and automated notifications.

🏢Multi-Site Control

Manage unlimited facilities from one Odoo instance with fully consolidated reporting.

Visual Overview

Odoo for Facility Management in Action

From logging the first maintenance request to closing the annual asset report — see how a complete Odoo implementation for facility management connects every part of your operation.

Maintenance Module

Real-Time Maintenance Management — From Request to Resolution

The Odoo Maintenance module gives facility managers complete visibility over every open, scheduled, and completed work order across all buildings. Technicians receive automated assignments, complete jobs on mobile, and close work orders with photos and time logs — all synced back instantly.

Preventive maintenance schedules run automatically so critical assets like HVAC, elevators, and fire systems are always serviced on time — before failures occur. This is one of the highest-value outcomes of a structured Odoo implementation for facility management businesses.

Asset Management

Complete Asset Register Across Every Building and Site

Odoo for Facility Management maintains a full, searchable register of every asset across all your properties — from HVAC units and elevators to electrical panels and generators. Track service history, warranty dates, depreciation, and current operational status in one place.

A well-executed Odoo implementation ensures that automated service reminders are configured from day one — so no asset falls outside its inspection window and every compliance record is linked, traceable, and audit-ready.

Field Service & Helpdesk

Dispatch and Track Field Technicians Across All Sites

Odoo's Field Service module connects your operations centre to every technician in the field. Managers assign jobs, track progress, and receive completion reports in real time — while technicians use the Odoo mobile app to view assignments, log time, capture photos, and close work orders on site.

Combined with the Odoo Helpdesk module, your facility management team handles all client and tenant requests with full SLA tracking and automated escalation. A proper Odoo implementation ensures these workflows are configured to your exact service contracts and client commitments from the start.

Multi-Site Reporting

Consolidated Reporting Across Every Building and Contract

With Odoo for Facility Management, operations managers gain a consolidated view of performance across every building, client contract, and service team — without switching between systems or manually consolidating reports from multiple sources.

Our Odoo implementation process includes building these reports and dashboards to match your specific KPIs during configuration — so your leadership team has the exact data they need from day one, whether that is maintenance costs per building, SLA compliance per client, or asset lifecycle performance across your full portfolio.

The Problem

Facility Management Challenges That Odoo for Facility Management Solves

Every facility management company faces the same daily operational pressures. Here is exactly how Odoo for Facility Management — with the right Odoo implementation — eliminates each one.

🗂️

Disconnected Systems and Data Silos

Maintenance tracking, asset registers, billing, and HR running on separate tools creates data gaps and duplicate errors. Odoo for Facility Management connects everything in one platform.

🔧

Reactive Maintenance and Unplanned Downtime

Without automated preventive scheduling, teams respond to breakdowns rather than preventing them. Odoo automates preventive maintenance so critical assets are always serviced on schedule.

📋

Inefficient Work Order Management

Manual work orders, paper job cards, and phone-based dispatch are slow and impossible to track at scale. A structured Odoo implementation replaces all of this with streamlined digital workflows.

📊

No Visibility Over Costs and Budgets

Without live cost tracking, maintenance budgets creep past projections unnoticed. Odoo gives managers real-time cost visibility per building, asset type, and service category at all times.

🏢

Multi-Site Operational Complexity

Coordinating technicians, spare parts, and reporting across multiple buildings manually is error-prone. Odoo gives you a unified view of all facilities in real time, from a single system.

🤝

Poor SLA Compliance and Client Communication

Without a structured helpdesk, responding to tenant and client requests is inconsistent. Missing SLA deadlines damages relationships and puts contract renewals at risk every quarter.

How Odoo Helps

How Odoo for Facility Management Makes Operations Simple

Odoo for Facility Management is designed around how facilities businesses actually operate. Every module connects to the next — and every Odoo implementation by Etriplesoft is configured to match your workflows exactly, so your team can focus on managing buildings, not software.

🔧

Maintenance Management

  • Corrective and preventive work orders in one system
  • Automated scheduling for recurring maintenance tasks
  • Real-time status tracking across all buildings and sites
  • Technician assignment based on skill and availability
  • Mobile completion with photos, signatures, and time logs
⚙️

Asset Management

  • Full asset register across all sites and buildings
  • Service history and warranty date tracking per asset
  • Automated inspection and service reminders
  • Depreciation tracking and financial integration
  • Compliance documents linked directly to each asset
👷

Field Service

  • Technician dispatch with availability and location view
  • Mobile app for job viewing and on-site completion
  • Capture photos, parts used, and time on-site
  • Real-time reporting back to the operations centre
  • SLA timers tracked automatically from dispatch to close
🎫

Helpdesk & SLA

  • Centralised client and tenant service request portal
  • Automatic ticket assignment and SLA countdown timers
  • Escalation rules and manager alerts for at-risk tickets
  • Client-facing status updates and email notifications
  • Full SLA compliance reporting per client and per site
📦

Inventory & Spare Parts

  • Track spare parts stock across all warehouses and stores
  • Automated reorder points and purchase request generation
  • Consumption tracked per work order and per asset
  • Emergency procurement alerts before stockouts occur
  • Full cost visibility of parts usage per building
💰

Accounting & Finance

  • Every work order cost posted to accounts automatically
  • Live budget tracking per building and service category
  • Client invoicing aligned with contract-based billing
  • VAT-compliant for UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt
  • Profit and loss per facility, per month, per contract
📊

Reporting & Analytics

  • Live operational dashboards for facility managers
  • MTTR, MTBF, and completion rate KPI reporting
  • Energy consumption monitoring and benchmarking
  • SLA compliance reports per client and per site
  • Executive summaries generated automatically on schedule
🏢

Multi-Site Management

  • One Odoo instance for unlimited facilities and buildings
  • Site-level and consolidated group performance dashboards
  • Centralised technician pool managed across all locations
  • Standard SOPs configured and enforced across every site
  • Client and contract management structured per property
Results

What Facility Management Companies Gain From Odoo

Real, measurable improvements reported by facility management companies following a successful Odoo implementation across UAE, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia.

40%Less Unplanned Downtime

Automated preventive maintenance ensures critical assets are serviced before failures happen — keeping buildings operational and tenants satisfied.

3×Faster Work Order Resolution

Structured digital dispatch and mobile job completion accelerates every work order from the initial request through to final close.

50%Less Administrative Work

Automated cost posting, client invoicing, and scheduled reports free your team from manual data collection and paperwork.

100%Tax Compliant

UAE VAT, ZATCA Phase 2, and ETA e-invoicing are handled automatically in every transaction from day one of go-live.

How We Work

Our Odoo Implementation Process for Facility Management

Our Odoo implementation methodology is designed specifically around how facility management businesses operate. From your first discovery call to team go-live, Etriplesoft guides every step of the process to ensure maximum adoption, minimum disruption, and fast time-to-value.

01🔍Discovery

We map your facilities, workflows, assets, and service contracts to define the right Odoo configuration for your business.

02🗺️System Design

Asset structure, maintenance workflows, SLA rules, and reporting are all designed to match your exact operational model.

03⚙️Build & Configure

Full Odoo implementation covering module setup, data migration, and local tax compliance for your market.

04🎓Training & Testing

Your full operations team is trained on every module. A complete simulation of live workflows is run before go-live.

05🚀Go Live & Support

We go live with your team on-site and provide dedicated post-implementation support throughout your first operational weeks.

Who Is It For

Odoo for Facility Management Works for Every Type of Facilities Business

Whether you manage a single site or operate as a multi-client FM contractor, our Odoo implementation scales to fit your operation exactly — from initial configuration through to multi-site expansion.

🏢 Commercial Property Management 🏘️ Residential Complex Management 🏭 Industrial Facility Management 🏨 Hotel Facilities Teams 🏥 Healthcare Facility Management 🏗️ Construction & Site Operations 🏬 Retail & Mall Management 🏛️ Government & Public Buildings 🌍 Multi-Site FM Contractors 🔌 MEP Service Companies
Why Choose Us

Why Facility Management Companies Choose Etriplesoft for Odoo Implementation

Etriplesoft is a certified Odoo partner with deep, hands-on expertise in delivering Odoo implementation projects for facility management businesses across Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia. We do not offer generic ERP rollouts. Every Odoo implementation we deliver is configured to match the specific operational workflows, reporting requirements, and compliance obligations of facility management companies in our region.

Our team of Odoo-certified consultants, developers, and project managers guides your business through every stage — from initial requirement scoping and system design to data migration, team training, and ongoing post-implementation support. Our structured From Setup To Success process ensures strong adoption across your full operations team and a go-live you can rely on.

10+Years of ERP Experience

Deep implementation expertise across facility management, real estate, and construction

500+Successful Implementations

Proven Odoo implementation track record across Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia

100%Odoo Certified

Certified partners delivering the latest Odoo v17 functionality with full local compliance

24/7Ongoing Support

Dedicated support team available post-implementation to keep your operations running smoothly

Explore More Industry Solutions

Want to learn more about the platform and our Odoo implementation approach? Read our full guide on the Odoo ERP system or explore other industry solutions below.

🏗️ Odoo for Construction 🍽️ Odoo for Restaurants 🗺️ From Setup To Success 📋 Requirements Workshop ⚙️ System Configuration 🎓 Team Training & Go-Live 🔗 Odoo ERP — Full Platform 📅 Request a Free Demo
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Odoo for Facility Management

What is Odoo for Facility Management? Odoo for Facility Management is an all-in-one ERP system that connects maintenance management, asset tracking, work orders, field service dispatch, helpdesk, inventory, and finance in a single platform — designed specifically for facility management businesses of every size and type. What is included in an Odoo implementation for a facility management company? A complete Odoo implementation for facility management covers module configuration across maintenance, assets, field service, helpdesk, and finance — plus data migration from your existing systems, local tax compliance setup, full team training, and post-go-live support. Etriplesoft's structured implementation process typically runs five phases from discovery through to live operations. What is the Odoo Maintenance module and how does it help facility managers? The Odoo Maintenance module allows facility managers to create, assign, and track both corrective and preventive maintenance requests in real time. It supports automated scheduling of recurring tasks, technician assignment, work order tracking, and performance reporting — significantly reducing reactive maintenance and improving asset uptime across all buildings. How does Odoo handle asset management for facility companies? Odoo's asset management functionality maintains a complete register of all physical assets across all sites. It tracks service history, warranty dates, depreciation schedules, and current operational status. During Odoo implementation, Etriplesoft configures automated service reminders and links maintenance records directly to each asset for full compliance traceability. How to manage multiple buildings and sites with Odoo for Facility Management? Odoo supports multi-site facility management from a single instance. You assign assets, work orders, technicians, and costs to specific buildings or locations, then view consolidated performance across all sites through a centralised dashboard — without needing separate systems or manual report consolidation for each property. How long does an Odoo implementation for a facility management company take? An Odoo implementation for facility management typically takes between 6 and 14 weeks with Etriplesoft, depending on the number of sites, modules, and data migration complexity. Overview

What Is Odoo for Real Estate?

Odoo for Real Estate is an all-in-one ERP system built to manage every part of a property business — from the first lead and property listing through lease management, maintenance, and financial reporting — inside a single connected platform.

Whether you run a boutique brokerage, a large-scale developer, or a facility management company, Odoo for Real Estate replaces scattered tools with one system that gives you real-time control over your portfolio, your team, and your finances.

At Etriplesoft, we implement and configure Odoo specifically for real estate companies across the UAE, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia — including local VAT compliance, Arabic interface support, and tenancy law contract formats from day one.

Request a Free Demo 🏠

Property Portfolio

Centralised database for all units, buildings, and land parcels with live status tracking.

📝

Lease Automation

Auto-generate contracts, track renewals, and send expiry alerts before losing a tenant.

💳

Smart Invoicing

Recurring rent invoices sent automatically with payment matching and overdue follow-ups.

🔑

CRM & Pipeline

Visual deal pipeline from first enquiry to signed contract with automated sequences.

🔧

Maintenance Portal

Tenant request portal, work order assignment, and preventive maintenance scheduling.

🌍

Multi-Branch Ready

Manage unlimited offices and portfolios from one instance with consolidated reporting.

The Problem

Challenges Real Estate Businesses Face Every Day

Every property company faces the same operational struggles. Here is exactly how Odoo for Real Estate eliminates each one.

🗂️

Fragmented Tools & Data Silos

CRM, listings, accounting, and lease management on separate systems creates data gaps, billing errors, and missed follow-ups. Odoo for Real Estate unifies everything in one platform.

📋

Manual Lease & Renewal Management

Lease expiry dates tracked in spreadsheets lead to missed renewals, vacant units, and revenue loss. Odoo automates contracts, escalation rules, and renewal reminders without manual effort.

💰

Slow Invoice & Payment Cycles

Manually generating rent invoices and chasing overdue payments wastes hours every week. Odoo automates recurring invoicing, payment matching, and late-payment follow-up sequences.

🔧

Untracked Maintenance Requests

Tenant requests arriving by phone or WhatsApp get lost, response times suffer, and tenants leave. Odoo provides a structured portal with work order assignment and live status updates.

📉

No Real-Time Portfolio Visibility

Without consolidated dashboards, executives cannot see occupancy rates, outstanding receivables, or property-level profitability — making strategic decisions pure guesswork.

🏗️

Off-Plan Project Delivery Chaos

Developers tracking construction milestones, contractor payments, and unit handovers across multiple tools face constant delays and cost overruns. Odoo connects every stage in one view.

How Odoo Helps

How Odoo for Real Estate Makes Operations Simple

Designed around how property businesses actually work — every module connects to the next so your team focuses on deals, not software.

🏠

Property Portfolio Management

  • Centralised database of all units, buildings, and parcels
  • Status tracking: available, reserved, sold, or leased
  • Unit specs, floor plans, and documents per property
  • Filterable views by type, location, price, and status
  • Automated listing updates across all channels
📝

Lease & Contract Automation

  • Automated lease generation with configurable templates
  • Rent escalation rules and renewal reminders built in
  • Digital signature integration for fast execution
  • Expiry alerts sent to both agents and tenants
  • Tenancy law compliance for UAE, KSA, and Egypt
💳

Billing, Invoicing & Payments

  • Recurring rent invoices generated and sent automatically
  • Payment matching with bank feed reconciliation
  • Overdue alerts and automated follow-up sequences
  • VAT-compliant invoicing for UAE, KSA, and Egypt
  • Cash flow forecasting from lease income schedules
🔑

CRM & Sales Pipeline

  • Visual pipeline from lead enquiry to signed contract
  • Automated follow-up emails and SMS sequences
  • Agent performance dashboards and activity tracking
  • Commission calculation and payroll sync built in
  • Customer portal for document sharing and e-signature
🔧

Maintenance & Facility Management

  • Tenant request portal with live status updates
  • Work order assignment to teams or contractors
  • Preventive maintenance scheduling for buildings
  • Cost tracking per property for accurate P&L
  • Contractor invoices linked to maintenance budgets
📊

Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Real-time occupancy dashboards across all properties
  • Revenue and expense reports per unit or portfolio
  • Consolidated group reporting across multiple branches
  • Custom KPI dashboards for executives and managers
  • Scheduled automated reports delivered to your inbox
Visual Overview

Odoo for Real Estate in Action

From the first property enquiry to closing the books at month-end — see how Odoo for Real Estate connects every part of your operation.

Portfolio & Lease Management Dashboard

See your entire property portfolio — occupancy, active leases, upcoming renewals, and revenue — all on one real-time Odoo dashboard.

Portfolio & Leases

CRM & Sales Pipeline for Property Deals

Every lead tracked from first enquiry through site visit, offer, and signed contract — with automated follow-ups and commission tracking built into Odoo.

CRM & Sales

All-in-One Real Estate ERP · Listings · Leases · CRM · Maintenance · Accounting · Analytics

One Odoo instance manages your entire real estate operation — from listing a property to handing over keys and collecting rent, every workflow connected and automated.

Full Platform Overview
Results

What Real Estate Companies Gain From Odoo

Real, measurable improvements reported by real estate businesses running Odoo for Real Estate across UAE, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia.

40%

Faster Deal Closing

Automated follow-ups and a structured CRM pipeline cut the average time to close a property deal significantly.

35%

Fewer Vacant Units

Proactive lease renewal alerts and tenant tracking reduce vacancy periods across the portfolio.

50%

Less Admin Work

Automated invoicing, closing reports, and contract generation free your team from hours of daily paperwork.

100%

Tax Compliant

UAE VAT, ZATCA Phase 2, and ETA e-invoicing handled automatically in every transaction — no manual filings.

How We Work

Our Odoo for Real Estate Implementation Process

From your first discovery call to your team going live — a structured 5-step process built around how real estate businesses operate.

We map your property workflows, lease processes, and pain points to define the right Odoo configuration.

Your team trained on every module. Full simulation run before go-live to catch every edge case.

05🚀

Go Live & Support

We go live with your team present and provide dedicated support through your first full business cycle.

Who Is It For

Odoo for Real Estate Works for Every Type of Property Business

From a single-agent brokerage to a national property developer — Odoo for Real Estate scales to fit your operation exactly.

Why Etriplesoft

Why Choose Etriplesoft to Implement Odoo for Real Estate

Choosing the right Odoo partner is as important as choosing Odoo itself. Etriplesoft brings deep real estate domain expertise with certified Odoo implementation experience across the MENA region.

Ongoing Support & Training

🔗 Related Odoo Industry Solutions by Etriplesoft

🏗️ Odoo for Construction 🍽️ Odoo for Restaurants ⚙️ Odoo ERP Platform 🔍 From Setup to Success 📋 Discovery & Planning 🚀 Go-Live & Support
FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions About Odoo for Real Estate

What is Odoo for Real Estate?+Odoo for Real Estate is an all-in-one ERP platform that manages property listings, lease contracts, CRM pipelines, maintenance requests, and financial reporting in a single connected system — eliminating the need for multiple disconnected tools. What is the difference between Odoo for Real Estate and standard property management software?+Standard property management tools cover only leasing and invoicing. Odoo for Real Estate includes native CRM, full accounting, maintenance management, payroll, project management, and business intelligence — making it a complete business operating system, not just a property tool. How to implement Odoo for Real Estate with Etriplesoft?+Etriplesoft follows a structured From Setup to Success process: discovery workshop, system configuration, data migration, user training, and go-live support. A typical real estate implementation takes 6 to 12 weeks depending on the number of branches and modules required. How to automate lease invoicing with Odoo for Real Estate?+Odoo's recurring invoice feature automatically generates and sends rent invoices on any schedule — monthly, quarterly, or annually — with payment reminders triggered automatically for overdue amounts. No manual work needed. How to manage multiple property branches with Odoo for Real Estate?+Odoo's multi-company and multi-branch architecture lets real estate businesses manage unlimited offices or portfolios from one instance, with consolidated group-level reporting and branch-level access controls for each team. Does Odoo for Real Estate support tax compliance in UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt?+Yes. Etriplesoft configures Odoo to be fully compliant across all three markets — UAE VAT and FTA returns, ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing for Saudi Arabia, and ETA e-invoicing portal integration for Egypt. What is the latest version of Odoo for Real Estate?+Etriplesoft implements Odoo version 17 — the latest release — which includes improved CRM automation, enhanced reporting dashboards, and updated compliance features relevant to MENA real estate markets.

.taxn{flex:1;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#C8DEFF}
.taxbg{flex:2;height:6px;background:#112B4E;border-radius:100px;overflow:hidden}
.taxf{height:100%;border-radius:100px}
.taxp{font-size:10px;color:#4A6FA0;width:36px;text-align:right}
.cal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:2px}
.cdn{font-size:8px;text-align:center;color:#2A4A70;font-weight:700;padding:2px 0}
.cd{font-size:9px;text-align:center;padding:3px 1px;border-radius:4px;color:#3A5A80}
.cd.task{background:rgba(27,111,228,.20);color:#60A5FA;font-weight:700}
.cd.today{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:700}
.cd.urg{background:rgba(248,113,113,.18);color:#F87171;font-weight:700}
.cd.pay{background:rgba(34,197,94,.18);color:#4ADE80;font-weight:700}
.cd.emp{opacity:0}
.bbar-bg{height:5px;background:#112B4E;border-radius:100px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:8px}
.bbar-f{height:100%;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cyan),var(--blue))}
.bbar-l{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9px;color:#3A5A80;margin-top:3px}
/* STATS RIBBON */
.ribbon{background:#0D2240;border-top:1px solid #1A3050;border-bottom:1px solid #1A3050}
.rib-in{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}
@media(max-width:700px){.rib-in{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.rsc{padding:24px 20px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.rsc:last-child{border:none}
.rsn{font-size:30px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.rsl{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.40);margin-top:5px}
/* QUICK STRIP */
.qstrip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:32px}
.qs{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--r);padding:22px 20px;transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .15s;border-top:3px solid var(--blue)}
.qs:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.qs-i{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:10px}
.qs-t{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#C8DEFF;margin-bottom:6px}
.qs-p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0;line-height:1.5}
/* CHALLENGES */
.chg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:32px}
.chc{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--r);padding:26px 24px;transition:box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s}
.chc:hover{box-shadow:var(--sh);border-color:var(--blue)}
.chi{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:12px}
/* VISUAL */
.vis-sec{background:var(--bg2)}
.vis-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:56px;margin-top:48px}
.vis-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.vis-row.rev{direction:rtl}.vis-row.rev>*{direction:ltr}
@media(max-width:720px){.vis-row,.vis-row.rev{grid-template-columns:1fr;direction:ltr}}
.vis-tag{display:inline-block;background:rgba(0,196,204,.12);color:var(--cyan);font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:12px;text-transform:uppercase}
.vis-txt h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:12px}
.vis-txt p{font-size:15px}
.vis-frame{border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 6px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.50);background:#0D2240;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block}
.vis-frame svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
/* MODULES */
.modg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:0;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--rl);overflow:hidden;margin-top:32px}
.modc{background:#0F1E35;padding:28px 26px;border-right:1px solid #1A3050;border-bottom:1px solid #1A3050;transition:background .2s}
.modc:hover{background:#112B4E}
.modi{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:14px}
.modc ul{list-style:none;margin-top:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.modc ul li{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);padding-left:14px;position:relative;line-height:1.5}
.modc ul li::before{content:'•';position:absolute;left:0;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:700}
/* ETA GUIDE */
.eta-sec{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0A1628 0%,#0D2240 50%,#112B4E 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.eta-sec::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-100px;right:-100px;width:500px;height:500px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(27,111,228,.2),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
.eta-steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:20px;position:relative;z-index:1;margin-top:36px}
.eta-step{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:var(--rl);padding:28px 24px}
.eta-num{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:1.1rem;margin-bottom:16px}
.eta-step h3{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.eta-step p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.eta-step code{display:inline-block;background:rgba(27,111,228,.25);color:#60A5FA;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:.8rem;margin-top:4px}
/* COMPARISON */
.comparison-wrap{width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;margin-top:40px;padding-top:18px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.comparison-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.88rem}
.comparison-table th{background:#0F1E35;padding:14px 18px;text-align:left;font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;color:#60A5FA;border-bottom:2px solid var(--border)}
.comparison-table th:first-child{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.comparison-table th.hl-col{background:rgba(27,111,228,.15);color:var(--cyan);position:relative;padding-top:28px}
.comparison-table th.hl-col::after{content:'Recommended';position:absolute;top:-14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.comparison-table td{padding:12px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);vertical-align:middle}
.comparison-table td.hl-col{background:rgba(27,111,228,.06);color:#C8DEFF;font-weight:500}
.comparison-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.comparison-table tr:hover td{background:#0F1E35}
.chk{color:var(--green);font-weight:700}.crs{color:var(--red)}.prt{color:var(--orange)}
@media(max-width:768px){
  .comparison-wrap{overflow:visible;padding-top:10px}
  .comparison-table,.comparison-table thead,.comparison-table tbody,.comparison-table th,.comparison-table td,.comparison-table tr{display:block;width:100%}
  .comparison-table thead{display:none}
  .comparison-table tbody{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
  .comparison-table tr{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
  .comparison-table td{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);white-space:normal}
  .comparison-table tr td:first-child{display:block;background:#112B4E;color:#E8F0FF;font-weight:700}
  .comparison-table tr td:not(:first-child)::before{content:attr(data-label);flex:0 0 42%;max-width:42%;color:#60A5FA;font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.35}
  .comparison-table td.hl-col{background:rgba(27,111,228,.08)}
}
/* CASE STUDY */
.case-card{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--rl);padding:44px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:center}
@media(max-width:720px){.case-card{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.case-tag{display:inline-block;background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);color:var(--green);border-radius:100px;padding:4px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}
.case-card h3{font-size:1.4rem;color:#E8F0FF;margin-bottom:.75rem;line-height:1.3}
.case-quote{background:var(--bg2);border-left:3px solid var(--blue);border-radius:0 var(--r) var(--r) 0;padding:14px 18px;margin-top:18px}
.case-quote p{font-style:italic;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.35rem}
.case-quote cite{font-size:.78rem;color:#4A6FA0;font-style:normal;font-weight:600}
.case-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.case-metric{background:var(--dark2);border-radius:var(--r);padding:22px 18px;text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--border)}
.case-metric-val{font-size:2rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan);line-height:1;margin-bottom:.35rem}
.case-metric-label{font-size:.8rem;color:#4A6FA0}
/* PRICING */
.pricing-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:32px}
.pricing-card{background:#0F1E35;border:1.5px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--rl);padding:30px 26px;position:relative;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.pricing-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh-lg)}
.pricing-card.featured{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(27,111,228,.2)}
.pricing-badge{position:absolute;top:-12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 16px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap;}
.pricing-tier{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:.4rem}
.pricing-card h3{font-size:1.2rem;color:#E8F0FF;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.pricing-range{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan);margin-bottom:.25rem}
.pricing-note{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:1.25rem;padding-bottom:1.25rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
.pricing-features{list-style:none}
.pricing-features li{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:5px 0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.pricing-features li::before{content:'✓';color:var(--green);font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0}
/* PROCESS */
.proc-sec{background:var(--bg2)}
.psteps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:0;margin-top:40px}
@media(max-width:800px){.psteps{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.ps{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-right:none;padding:28px 22px;text-align:center;transition:background .2s}
.ps:last-child{border-right:1px solid #1A3050}
.ps:hover{background:#112B4E}
.pnum{width:36px;height:36px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 12px}
.pico{font-size:26px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ptit{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:#C8DEFF;margin-bottom:6px}
.ptxt{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;margin:0}
/* BENEFITS */
.beng{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:32px}
.benc{background:#0F1E35;border-radius:var(--r);padding:24px;box-shadow:var(--sh);border-top:3px solid var(--blue)}
.bn{font-size:38px;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan);line-height:1;margin-bottom:6px}
.bl{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#C8DEFF;margin-bottom:8px}
/* WHO */
.wtags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:28px}
.wtag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#0F1E35;border:1.5px solid #1A3050;border-radius:100px;padding:9px 18px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#C8DEFF;transition:all .2s}
.wtag:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue)}
/* WHY */
.whyg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:32px}
.whyc{background:#112B4E;border-radius:var(--r);padding:28px 22px;text-align:center;border:1px solid #1A3A5C;border-top:3px solid var(--blue)}
.wyn{font-size:38px;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan);line-height:1;margin-bottom:8px}
.wyt{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#E8F0FF;margin-bottom:6px}
.wyd{font-size:12px;color:#5A80A8;margin:0;line-height:1.5}
/* RELATED */
.relbox{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--rl);padding:32px 36px}
.rellinks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
.rlink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#112B4E;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:100px;padding:8px 18px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#60A5FA;transition:all .2s}
.rlink:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue);text-decoration:none}
/* FAQ */
.faqlist{margin-top:32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.faqitem{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden}
.faqq{padding:18px 22px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;color:#C8DEFF;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;user-select:none;transition:background .15s}
.faqq:hover{background:#112B4E}
.faqq::after{content:'+';font-size:22px;color:var(--cyan);font-weight:300;line-height:1}
.faqq.open{background:#112B4E}
.faqq.open::after{content:'−'}
.faqa{padding:0 22px 18px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;display:none}
.faqa.open{display:block}
.faqa code{background:rgba(27,111,228,.15);color:#60A5FA;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:.82rem}
/* CTA */
.ctasec{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0A1628 0%,#0D2240 40%,#1A3A5C 70%,#1B5FC4 100%);padding:80px 0;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ctasec::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 60%,rgba(0,196,204,.18) 0%,transparent 50%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 20%,rgba(27,111,228,.25) 0%,transparent 50%);pointer-events:none}
.ctasec h2{color:#fff;margin-bottom:16px}
.ctasec p{color:#8AAFD8;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto 32px;font-size:17px}
.cta-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.38);font-size:13px;margin-top:16px}
.cta-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;z-index:1}
/* BLOG CLUSTER */
.blog-sec{background:var(--bg2)}
.blog-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:32px}
.blog-card{background:#0F1E35;border:1px solid #1A3050;border-radius:var(--rl);padding:26px 24px;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s}
.blog-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--sh-lg);border-color:var(--blue)}
.blog-cat{display:inline-block;background:rgba(0,196,204,.12);color:var(--cyan);border-radius:100px;padding:3px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:12px}
.blog-card h3{font-size:.95rem;color:#C8DEFF;margin-bottom:8px;line-height:1.4}
.blog-card p{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.6}
.blog-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-lt)}
.blog-link:hover{color:var(--cyan);text-decoration:none}
/* AUTHOR BOTTOM */
.author-bottom{background:var(--surface);border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:48px 0}
.author-bottom-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:start}
@media(max-width:680px){.author-bottom-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.author-avatar-lg{width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--dark3));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:1.4rem;color:#fff;flex-shrink:0;border:3px solid rgba(27,111,228,.4)}
.author-bottom-name{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:800;color:#E8F0FF;margin-bottom:4px}
.author-bottom-role{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px}
.author-bottom-bio{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;max-width:640px;margin-bottom:14px}
.author-bottom-badges{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ab-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:rgba(27,111,228,.18);color:#60A5FA;border:1px solid rgba(27,111,228,.3);border-radius:100px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.ab-badge.gold{background:rgba(252,211,77,.12);color:#FCD34D;border-color:rgba(252,211,77,.3)}
.author-bottom-meta{text-align:right;font-size:.78rem;color:#4A6FA0;line-height:1.8}
@media(max-width:680px){.author-bottom-meta{text-align:left}}
</style>
</head>

    🧾<h3>ETA E-Invoicing Compliance Complexity</h3><p>Egypt's ETA e-invoicing mandate requires real-time invoice submission via API. Odoo handles UUID generation, digital signing, and ETA portal transmission automatically — zero manual compliance steps required.</p>
    🏦<h3>Time-Consuming Bank Reconciliation</h3><p>Manually matching bank statements to accounting records wastes hours every month. Odoo connects live bank feeds and uses AI-assisted matching rules to reconcile in minutes, not days.</p>
    📊<h3>No Real-Time Financial Visibility</h3><p>Waiting for month-end reports to understand your position is too slow. Odoo delivers live dashboards showing cash flow, profitability, and receivables at any moment — on desktop or mobile.</p>
    🌍<h3>Complex Multi-Jurisdiction Tax Compliance</h3><p>Managing UAE VAT (5%), ZATCA Phase 2 for Saudi Arabia, and ETA for Egypt simultaneously is operationally demanding. Odoo handles all three automatically within one ERP system.</p>

  FAQ
  <h2>Frequently Asked Questions About Odoo for Accounting in Egypt, UAE & Saudi Arabia</h2>
    Is Odoo free for accounting?Odoo Community is free and includes basic accounting features. The Enterprise edition — which includes full bank reconciliation, ETA e-invoicing, ZATCA Phase 2, AI-assisted matching, and mobile expense capture — requires a per-user monthly subscription. For most Egypt and GCC businesses, Enterprise is required for full compliance coverage. Etriplesoft will recommend the right edition during your discovery session.
    What is Odoo for Accounting?<strong>Odoo for Accounting</strong> is a fully integrated ERP accounting module that manages invoicing, expense tracking, bank reconciliation, tax compliance, and financial reporting within a single connected platform. It eliminates the need for separate accounting software by connecting finance directly to sales, purchasing, inventory, and payroll in Odoo ERP.
    How does Odoo handle ETA e-invoicing in Egypt?Odoo integrates directly with the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) portal via API. Once configured, every confirmed invoice is automatically validated, digitally signed, assigned a UUID, and transmitted to ETA in real time. Etriplesoft configures your <code>ETA Client ID</code>, <code>ETA Secret</code>, branch codes, and activity codes during implementation — so ETA compliance is fully automatic from day one with no manual intervention required.
    How much does Odoo accounting implementation cost?We don't offer fixed pricing tiers because every accounting operation is different. Your implementation is scoped and priced based on your entity structure, compliance markets, modules required, and data migration complexity. Book a free 45-minute discovery call and we will deliver a detailed fixed-price proposal within 48 hours — no obligation.
    How long does an Odoo accounting implementation take?All <strong>Odoo for Accounting</strong> implementations by Etriplesoft go live in a minimum of 6 weeks from kick-off — this ensures proper configuration, data migration, team training, and testing are completed without shortcuts. Multi-company or multi-jurisdiction projects typically run 10–16 weeks depending on complexity. The exact timeline is agreed with you at the discovery appointment before any work begins.
    Does Odoo support ZATCA Phase 2 for Saudi Arabia?Yes. <strong>Odoo for Accounting</strong> v17 includes built-in ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing compliance for Saudi Arabia, covering B2B and B2C invoices, QR code generation, cryptographic signing, and automatic submission to the ZATCA platform. Etriplesoft configures and tests full ZATCA compliance as part of every Saudi Arabia implementation, and can handle dual-jurisdiction setups (Egypt ETA + ZATCA Phase 2) within a single Odoo instance.
    What is the difference between Odoo Accounting and Odoo Invoicing?Odoo Invoicing is a lighter module for customer billing, payment tracking, and basic expense management — suitable for businesses without a double-entry accounting requirement. Odoo Accounting is the full module with a complete general ledger, journal entries, bank reconciliation, multi-currency, tax reporting, and ETA compliance. For any business with employees, multiple bank accounts, or tax compliance requirements in Egypt or GCC, Odoo Accounting is the right choice.
    Can Odoo replace QuickBooks or Sage for an Egyptian company?Yes, and for most Egyptian businesses <strong>Odoo for Accounting</strong> is the stronger choice. QuickBooks does not natively support ETA e-invoicing, has no Arabic interface, and lacks ERP integration with sales, inventory, and HR. Sage supports more accounting depth but requires third-party addons for ETA and ZATCA compliance. Odoo covers ETA, ZATCA, and UAE VAT natively in v17 — with a full Arabic UI and native ERP integration — making it purpose-built for MENA compliance requirements.
    Why should businesses choose Etriplesoft for Odoo accounting implementation?Etriplesoft is a certified Odoo partner based in Cairo with 10+ years of ERP delivery experience across Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia. Every implementation follows a structured From Setup To Success methodology covering discovery, system design, configuration, data migration, team training, and go-live support — with full local tax compliance from day one.

Odoo ITSM Helpdesk

Home › Solutions › Odoo ITSM Helpdesk
Odoo 17, 18, 19 Enterprise · Custom ITIL Suite

Odoo ITSM Helpdesk — ITIL Service Management for Odoo Enterprise

Etriplesoft's purpose-built Odoo ITSM Helpdesk — the leading IT service management software Egypt, helpdesk software Dubai, and Odoo ITSM Saudi Arabia implementation partner — consolidates ServiceNow-style best practices and native Odoo helpdesk module into a single ITIL-aligned application — with CAB approvals, SLA automation, a full CMDB, and a Known Error Database.

Why IT Teams Outgrow Generic Helpdesks

Odoo ITSM was built precisely because generic ticketing tools lack ITIL structure. Here is the gap most IT teams discover only after going live with a basic helpdesk.

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk was built for exactly this problem — a single, ITIL-aligned Odoo helpdesk module that replaces your disconnected tools without requiring a ServiceNow budget. For Odoo ITSM Egypt and GCC teams, this means enterprise-grade ITIL on the same Odoo instance — with zero extra cost. Etriplesoft's Odoo ITSM Egypt team handles Arabic configuration, ETA compliance, and user training.

IT Service Management isn't email ticketing. You deal with incidents that hide deeper problems, changes that need formal CAB sign-off, assets that depend on other assets, and SLA clocks that cannot miss a beat. Standard Odoo Helpdesk — or any generic ticket tool — doesn't speak ITIL. It gives you a queue, not a discipline.

We've seen it repeatedly: IT managers juggling ServiceNow for changes, Odoo for tickets, Excel for the asset list, and WhatsApp for CAB approvals. The cost? Missed SLAs, unapproved changes in production, duplicate incidents investigated three times, and zero traceability when auditors arrive. Etriplesoft's ITSM Helpdesk Module changes that — a single, standalone application that runs every ITIL practice end-to-end on Odoo Enterprise.

🎯

Subjective Priorities

Without a formal matrix, "Critical" means different things to different agents. Our Impact × Urgency matrix auto-computes priority every time — zero argument.

⏱️

SLA Blindness

Generic queues don't track response vs resolution deadlines separately. Our SLA engine auto-matches policies and colour-codes every ticket: On Track → At Risk → Breached.

🚫

Unapproved Changes

A firmware push with no CAB sign-off is an outage waiting to happen. Our workflow blocks implementation until the Change Advisory Board approves.

🧩

Siloed Records

Tickets, problems, changes, and assets live in disconnected tabs. Smart-button cross-links make every record traceable — one click from incident to asset.

Deployed Across the Region

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk is the #1 Odoo helpdesk module deployed by Etriplesoft — covering Odoo ITSM Egypt, Odoo helpdesk UAE, and Odoo ITSM Saudi Arabia clients on Odoo 17, 18, and 19 Enterprise.

🇪🇬 IT service management software Egypt 🇦🇪 helpdesk software Dubai 🇸🇦 Odoo ITSM Saudi Arabia

What Is the Etriplesoft Odoo Helpdesk Module?

Odoo ITSM is a fully standalone module on Odoo Enterprise — no third-party ITSM platform required. It covers every ITIL v4 practice from first ticket to post-implementation review inside your existing Odoo database.

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk is a standalone module installed directly on your Odoo Enterprise instance — no external integration required. It implements the full ITIL v4 practice set inside Odoo, making it the most integrated Odoo ITSM Helpdesk solution available for Odoo 17, 18, and 19. As a native Odoo helpdesk module, it shares the same user interface, security model, and data layer as every other Odoo application.

It's a fully integrated, custom-built application on Odoo Enterprise — not an extension of the standard Helpdesk app and not a bundle of third-party add-ons. It consolidates the best of two worlds: ServiceNow's ITIL rigour (Impact×Urgency, CAB, KEDB) and Odoo's elegant UX (Kanban, Chatter, smart buttons). It ships with its own menu, its own models (itsm.ticket, itsm.problem, itsm.change, itsm.asset, itsm.sla.policy, itsm.kb.article), its own security groups, and a full set of demo data.

⚡ One Database, Total Traceability

From the first user complaint to the final Post-Implementation Review, every record is linked. Ticket → Problem → Known Error → KB Article → Change → CAB Approval → Implementation → PIR. No re-entry. No reconciliation. Auditors love it.

The 6-Phase ITIL Lifecycle — End to End

The end-to-end lifecycle inside Odoo ITSM moves every IT request through a structured, ITIL-aligned pipeline — from service request intake through incident resolution, problem root-cause analysis, change approval, and CMDB update.

Every phase of the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk lifecycle maps directly to ITIL v4 practices — from the first ticket triage to post-implementation review and KEDB update. This makes the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk the only Odoo helpdesk module that covers the complete ITIL service management lifecycle without any third-party add-ons.

Every module is designed around one continuous flow. A single incident can surface a recurring problem, which becomes a Known Error, which triggers a formal change — all inside the same database, with every relationship explicit and auditable.

01 Intake & ClassificationIncident vs Service Request

Users raise tickets via portal, email, or direct entry. The system auto-generates references (INC00001 / SR00001), applies the Impact × Urgency matrix to compute priority, and auto-matches the best-fit SLA policy — all before the first agent sees it.

02 Assignment & TriageAuto-balanced routing

Tickets are routed to teams with three assignment modes: Manual, Random (round-robin), or Balanced (fewest open tickets). Agents see the Kanban pipeline: New → Assigned → In Progress → On Hold → Resolved → Closed. "On Hold" pauses the SLA clock automatically.

03 Problem IdentificationRoot cause analysis

When one ticket reveals a systemic issue, agents click "Create Problem" to spawn a Problem record with a dedicated Root Cause Analysis pipeline: New → Assessment → RCA → Fix in Progress → Resolved. Root causes are categorised (Hardware, Software Bug, Config, Network, Security, Human Error, Vendor).

04 Known Error & KnowledgeKEDB auto-publish

Mark a problem as Known Error, add a workaround, and the system auto-creates a Knowledge Base article with the correct category and visibility. Agents solve future tickets in minutes by referencing the KEDB — not by re-investigating.

05 Change Management & CABRisk-gated approval

Permanent fixes become Change Requests: Draft → Assessment → CAB Authorization → Scheduled → Implementation → PIR → Closed. Normal + High-Risk changes automatically require CAB approval. The "Start Implementation" button is blocked until CAB has signed off.

06 Post-Implementation ReviewOutcome tracking

After implementation, a formal PIR records outcome (Successful / Partial / Failed / Rolled Back) and links back to the originating problem and tickets. The CMDB updates affected Configuration Items. The loop is closed.

Deep Dive: 8 Core Components of the Odoo Helpdesk Module

Each of the eight components inside Odoo ITSM is pre-connected — tickets link to problems, problems trigger changes, and every resolved issue feeds the Knowledge Base automatically.

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk ships with eight tightly integrated components, each configurable to your IT team's specific processes without custom development.

📊 Dashboard

  • Live KPIs: open, breached, unassigned
  • Kanban by Stage + List + Pivot + Graph
  • Cross-tab: Ticket Type × Stage × Priority
  • One-click drill-down from every tile

🎫 Tickets (Incident / Service Request)

  • Impact × Urgency → Priority auto-compute
  • 6-stage pipeline with SLA pause on "On Hold"

  • Separate response vs resolution targets
  • Status auto-badge: On Track / At Risk / Breached / Met
  • Escalation contacts notified on breach

📚 Knowledge Base

  • 7 categories incl. FAQ, How-To, Known Error
  • 3 visibility levels: Draft / Internal / Public Portal
  • Up/down voting with computed score ranking

📈 Reports & Analytics

  • SLA Compliance (stacked bar by priority)
  • Volume Trends (line chart by ticket type)
  • Category Breakdown (pie chart)
  • Team Performance (pivot: team × stage × SLA)

Screen-by-Screen — Four More Views with Live Demo Data

Every screen inside the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk ships preloaded with realistic demo data — 10 tickets, 4 problems, 4 changes, 7 assets — so your team can evaluate the full workflow on day one.

Root Cause (Confirmed)

MTU mismatch between ISP edge (1500) and OpenVPN server MTU setting (1400). TCP MSS clamping is not applied, causing fragmentation that triggers connection drops.

🛠️ Workaround (Active)

Keepalive interval increased to 15s. Auto-reconnect script deployed to all client devices.

🔄 Permanent Fix — CHG00001

Reconfigure MTU and enable TCP MSS clamping. Awaiting CAB approval.

Impact × Urgency → Priority (Never Set by Hand)

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk calculates ticket priority automatically using the standard ITIL Impact × Urgency matrix — eliminating the inconsistency of manual triage.

One of the most damaging habits in IT support is subjective priority. One agent calls it "Urgent", another calls it "Normal", and the queue becomes meaningless. We adopted the ServiceNow 3×3 matrix: Priority is always computed from the intersection of Impact (how widespread) and Urgency (how time-sensitive). The result drives SLA auto-matching — so the moment an agent sets the two inputs, the entire downstream response plan locks in.

Urgency: High Urgency: Medium Urgency: Low Impact: High ★★★★ CRITICAL ★★★ HIGH ★★ MEDIUM Impact: Medium ★★★ HIGH ★★ MEDIUM ★ LOW Impact: Low ★★ MEDIUM ★ LOW ★ LOW

Impact measures the breadth of effect: High = a service outage hitting the whole company, Medium = a department, Low = a single user. Urgency measures time-pressure: High = immediate, Medium = soon, Low = when convenient. Managers can override the computed value when they must — but the moment Impact or Urgency change, the override is recalculated.

SLA Engine — Auto-Match, Auto-Track, Auto-Escalate

The SLA engine inside Odoo ITSM auto-assigns the correct service level agreement at ticket creation — based on team, priority, and category — with breach alerts firing before the clock runs out.

The SLA engine inside the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk automatically matches each ticket to the correct policy, tracks response and resolution timers in real time, and escalates before a breach occurs.

The SLA engine is the beating heart of the module. Every ticket gets a policy the second it's saved, and the status is visible at a glance throughout its life. No manual timers, no spreadsheet tracking, no end-of-month surprises.

● On Track → ● At Risk (<2h) → ● Breached → ● Met ✓

Four Pre-Configured SLA Policies — Ready on Day One

🔴

Critical Incidents

0.5h response · 4h resolution. Applies to incidents with ★★★★ Critical priority only.

🟠

High Priority Support

1h response · 8h resolution. Applies to all types with ★★★ High priority and above.

🟡

Standard Support

4h response · 24h resolution. The default policy for ★★ Medium priority tickets.

🟢

Service Requests

8h response · 72h resolution. Provisioning, access, and routine service requests.

Policies support business-hours calculation via Odoo's resource calendar, so a ticket raised at 5:59 PM on Thursday doesn't eat a weekend. Moving a ticket to "On Hold" pauses the clock automatically. Breach triggers escalation to the contacts you've configured. Every minute is audited in the Chatter.

Change Advisory Board — Risk-Gated, Never Skippable

The CAB workflow inside Odoo ITSM enforces risk-gated approvals before any change is implemented — protecting production systems from unreviewed modifications.

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk change management module enforces CAB approval as a gating condition — no change record can advance to implementation without the required approvals in place.

The fastest route to a production outage is a firmware upgrade nobody approved. The module enforces CAB governance based on change type and risk level — automatically, with no way to bypass the gate.

Standard ChangePre-approved

Routine, low-risk, well-documented procedures (e.g. rolling a single switch's firmware back). CAB status auto-sets to "Not Required". Implementation can begin immediately.

Normal ChangeCAB if High/Critical risk

The default change category. When Risk Level is set to High or Critical, the "CAB Approval Required" flag auto-checks. Implementation is blocked until CAB approves — the system raises a UserError if you try.

Emergency ChangeAlways CAB (retrospective)

For urgent fixes like an active security incident. CAB approval is always required but can be obtained retroactively. Full audit trail of who approved, when, and why.

The CAB Workflow — Six Formal Steps

Draft → Assessment → CAB Authorization → Scheduled → Implementation → PIR → Closed ✓

Each change carries structured documentation across dedicated tabs — Planning (Implementation, Rollback, Test, and Communication Plans), Risk (Risk Level, Risk Assessment, Impact Analysis, Business Justification), Schedule (Planned vs Actual Start/End for variance analysis), CAB (Approvers, Approval Date, Meeting Notes), and PIR (Outcome, Notes, Date).

Built for Daily Agent Productivity

Beyond ITIL compliance, the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk is designed for the agents who live inside it eight hours a day. Whether you are running Odoo ITSM Egypt, Odoo helpdesk UAE, or any Odoo ITSM Saudi Arabia deployment, keyboard shortcuts, smart filters, canned responses, and a unified inbox are all available from day one.

ITIL on paper is a discipline. ITIL in practice is what happens when tired agents face angry users at 4 PM on a Friday. These are the everyday features that keep the discipline effortless — the Odoo-native touches that turn a standards-compliant system into one your team actually enjoys using.

🌐 Customer Self-Service Portal

  • End-users raise tickets from the public portal — no internal login needed
  • Customers track ticket status and history in real time
  • Public KB articles surface self-service answers before a ticket is even opened
  • Portal users only see what you choose to publish

💬 Full Chatter & Audit Trail

  • Every ticket, problem, change, and asset carries an embedded collaboration stream
  • Internal notes stay internal; email replies auto-log against the record
  • Schedule Activities (To-Do, Call, Meeting) on any record with due dates
  • Auditors see every action with timestamp and author — no extra effort

🔗 Smart Button Cross-Navigation

  • One click from an incident to its problem, from the problem to its change
  • From a CI to every ticket and change that ever touched it
  • Bidirectional Many2many relationships keep the graph consistent
  • No more tab-hopping or manual reference lookups

⭐ Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

  • Customers rate the resolution when a ticket is closed
  • CSAT feeds directly into Team Performance reports
  • See which teams actually delight users — not just clear queues
  • Identifies agents and categories needing coaching

🏷️ Rich Categorization & Tagging

  • 8 predefined categories: Hardware, Software, Network, Security, Access, Email, Database, Other
  • Free-form tags for custom filtering (vendor, site, project)
  • Powers the Category Breakdown pie chart and pivot analytics
  • Laser-precise filters for power users

🚨 Visual SLA Urgency

  • Red "Breached" ribbon auto-appears at the top of the ticket form
  • Kanban cards turn red on breach — impossible to miss
  • List rows decorate amber (At Risk) / red (Breached)
  • Agents see priority without reading a single field

🔎 Power-User Search, Filter & Group-By

Built-in saved filters (My Tickets, Unassigned, SLA Breached, At Risk, Critical/High) and group-by options (Type, Stage, Priority, Team, Assignee, Category, SLA Status, Created Month) turn the ticket list into a live analytics surface. Every dashboard drill-down is one click away.

🔒 support.company.com/my/tickets 🏢 Acme Corp · IT Self-Service My Tickets Knowledge Base SM

My IT Tickets

Open (3)Resolved (12)All (15) INC00002

VPN Gateway Unreachable — Remote Workers

📅 Opened 2h ago👤 Omar Hakim⏱️ Response 14 min In Progress SR00007

New Employee Onboarding — Ahmed Hassan

📅 3 days ago👤 Dina Mostafa⏸ Paused — awaiting HR On Hold SR00008

Adobe Creative Cloud License Renewal

📅 5 days ago👤 Lina Tawfik In Progress

💡 Answers You Might Need — Based on Your Recent Tickets

Before raising a new ticket, these articles may solve it immediately:

📘 How to Reset Your VPN Connection 📘 Troubleshooting: ERP Running Slowly 📘 Password Reset Guide

↑ End-users raise, track, and self-serve — deflecting repeat tickets before they even reach the queue.

Security & Governance — Three Roles, Clear Boundaries

Odoo ITSM ships with three pre-configured role types — ensuring clear access boundaries between IT agents, IT managers, and end users without any custom development.

The module ships with three security groups under the ITSM category — each progressively broader than the last. No need to hand-craft custom access rules; the permission matrix is correct out of the box.

👤

ITSM Agent

Read / Write / Create on Tickets, Problems, Changes, Assets, KB Articles, Tags. Read-only on SLA Policies, Stages, and Teams. Cannot delete records. The default role for your support team.

🛡️

ITSM Manager

Full CRUD including Delete across every model. Can configure Stages, SLA Policies, Teams, and Tags. Sees the Configuration menu. The role for IT Service Managers and team leads.

✅

ITSM CAB Member

Read + Write on Change Requests only (no Create, no Delete). Used strictly for Change Advisory Board approvers — typically senior engineers, InfoSec, and business-unit stakeholders.

Measurable Outcomes from Our Clients

Organisations across Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia that deployed Odoo ITSM through Etriplesoft have reported these improvements in the first quarter post go-live.

IT teams that deployed the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk through Etriplesoft consistently report the same improvements across ticket resolution, SLA compliance, and change success rates.

55%

3×

KEDB Reuse Rate

Regional Deployments

Odoo ITSM Helpdesk — Egypt, UAE & Saudi Arabia

🇪🇬 Odoo ITSM Egypt

The leading IT service management software Egypt teams use to consolidate tickets, SLA tracking, and CMDB on one Odoo database. Arabic-interface ready.

🇦🇪 Odoo Helpdesk UAE

Dubai and Abu Dhabi IT teams deploy our helpdesk software Dubai configuration — full VAT 5% billing integration, SLA templates, and Arabic support from day one.

🇸🇦 Odoo ITSM Saudi Arabia

Odoo ITSM Saudi Arabia deployments include ZATCA-compliant billing, Vision 2030 digital-transformation alignment, and Arabic RTL interface across all ITIL modules.

📌 Case Study: GulfNet ICT Services — Odoo Helpdesk UAE Deployment

This case study shows how the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk was deployed for a UAE-based ICT services firm — from initial ticket backlog to a fully operational ITIL workflow within eight weeks.

A real-world helpdesk software Dubai deployment — rolling out across a 12-person IT team in 6 weeks.

"Before Etriplesoft, our Level-1 team spent 40% of their day chasing ticket priority with managers and looking up passwords in three spreadsheets. After we rolled out the ITSM Helpdesk Module, priority is never disputed, SLAs are colour-coded on every screen, and our Known Error Database resolves 6 out of 10 repeat incidents in under five minutes. CAB approvals that used to happen in WhatsApp now have a full audit trail."

— Karim El-Sherif, IT Service Manager ⭐ 2,400+ tickets handled / quarter

Who Benefits Most from the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk?

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk — deployed as Odoo ITSM Egypt, Odoo helpdesk UAE, and ITSM in Saudi Arabia — serves every type of IT organisation running Odoo Enterprise, from 5-person IT teams to enterprise IT departments managing thousands of assets.

🏢 In-House IT Departments 💻 Managed Service Providers 🌐 ICT Systems Integrators 🏦 Banks & Financial Services 🏥 Hospitals & Healthcare IT 🎓 Universities & Schools 🏭 Manufacturing IT/OT 🛰️ Telecom & ISP Operations

Trusted by IT Leaders Across the Region

From Odoo ITSM Egypt corporate deployments to Odoo helpdesk UAE service desks and ITSM in Saudi Arabia enterprise rollouts, IT managers trust the Odoo ITSM Helpdesk to run their service desk, manage changes, and maintain CMDB accuracy.

"The Impact × Urgency matrix ended a two-year argument inside my team. Priority is now math, not opinion. Our SLA compliance jumped from 68% to 94% in the first quarter."

— Dina Mostafa, Head of IT Operations (Egypt)

"CAB used to mean a WhatsApp group at 2 AM. Now every change has an implementation plan, a rollback plan, and a signed-off approver. Audit season is boring — and that's a massive compliment."

— Omar Al-Harbi, CISO (KSA)

"Linking tickets to CIs in the CMDB is the feature I didn't know I needed. When the ERP DB server throws an alert, I see every dependent service and every historical incident in one click."

— Priya Menon, Infrastructure Lead (UAE)

Our 5-Step Implementation (Zero Disruption)

Etriplesoft follows a structured 5-step process to deploy Odoo ITSM without disrupting your active IT operations — typically going live with Tickets + SLA + KB first, then Changes + CMDB in phase two.

Deploying the ITSM platform through Etriplesoft follows a structured 5-step process refined across dozens of ITSM software Egypt, helpdesk software Dubai, and ITSM in Saudi Arabia rollouts.

01 🔍 Discovery

We map your current ticketing flow, change process, CMDB maturity, and SLA commitments.

02 🗺️ Design

Configure teams, stages, SLA policies, CAB members, KB categories, and security groups.

03 ⚙️ Migrate & Build

Import existing tickets and asset inventory. Configure auto-assignment rules. UAT on demo data.

04 🎓 Training

Role-based training: agents, managers, CAB members, end-users on the portal.

05 🚀 Go-Live & Support

Hypercare period with dedicated support, dashboards reviewed weekly for the first month.

Frequently Asked Questions About Odoo ITSM Helpdesk

Common questions about Odoo ITSM — from ITIL compliance and CMDB setup to implementation timelines and licensing for Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

Is this a replacement for Odoo's standard Helpdesk app?Yes. Our ITSM Helpdesk is a standalone application — it doesn't depend on the standard Helpdesk module. It has its own menu, models, stages, and security groups. You can install them side-by-side if you want, but most clients uninstall the standard one to avoid confusion. Does it depend on third-party apps or Odoo Studio?No. The module depends only on Odoo's standard dependencies: base, mail, portal, and resource. No OCA apps, no Studio, no external paid modules. How does the CAB approval actually block an unapproved change?When a Normal change is flagged with High or Critical risk (or when it's an Emergency change), the "Start Implementation" button raises a UserError until CAB approval is recorded. The error message is explicit: "CAB approval is required before implementation." There is no technical workaround. Can the SLA timer pause automatically when we're waiting on the customer?Yes. The "On Hold" stage has an sla_paused flag set to True. Moving a ticket into On Hold pauses the clock; moving it back to an active stage resumes it. The full pause history is auditable. What happens when a problem is marked as a Known Error?If a workaround has been documented, the system automatically creates a Knowledge Base article with category "Known Error", visibility "Internal", and content combining the workaround and root cause. The article is linked back to the problem. Your Level-1 team gets a self-growing KEDB without lifting a finger. Does it come with demo data so we can evaluate before committing?Yes — the ITSM platform includes 10 realistic tickets, 4 problems, 4 changes, 7 assets, 4 SLA policies, and 5 KB articles loaded automatically. You can walk the full ITIL lifecycle on day one — perfect for evaluating before committing to go-live. How long until we go live?Typically 4–10 weeks depending on volume of legacy tickets, CMDB complexity, and integration needs. Etriplesoft deploys for ITSM software Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia clients on the same structured timeline — Tickets + SLA + KB first, then Changes + CMDB in phase two.

Yes. Our Odoo ITSM in Egypt deployments are configured specifically as ITSM software Egypt teams need — Arabic UI, ETA billing integration, local support, and full onboarding.

Does this work as helpdesk software in Dubai?

Absolutely. Our helpdesk software Dubai configuration includes VAT 5% billing, multi-branch support, and English/Arabic bilingual interface — deployed as part of our standard package.

Which helpdesk module should Saudi teams use?

The Odoo ITSM Helpdesk is the recommended module for ITSM in Saudi Arabia deployments — ZATCA-compliant, Arabic-first, and fully aligned to Vision 2030 digital transformation requirements.

Give your team the ITIL discipline of ServiceNow with the elegance of Odoo — in a single, standalone, standard module. Fully hosted. Fully yours.

Home › Solutions › Odoo Education Management System
Odoo Education Management System · Education ERP Suite · Arabic-Ready

Odoo Education Management System — One ERP for Every School Operation

E-TripleSoft implements the Odoo Education Management System — a complete education ERP software that unifies Admissions, Enrollments, Students, Fees, Library, Transport, and Parent/Student Portals under one database for schools, colleges, and training institutes in Egypt, UAE, and Saudi Arabia, with full Arabic language support out of the box.

📅 Request Your Free Demo → ▶ Explore the ERP Modules 12Integrated ERP Modules 4Role-Based Portals EN/ARBilingual Ready 1 DBOne Source of Truth ✔ Odoo Gold Partner · Egypt, UAE & Saudi Arabia ✔ Community & Enterprise Compatible

📑 In This Guide

  • Why Schools Outgrow Spreadsheets
  • What Is Odoo Education ERP?
  • Admission-to-Graduation Lifecycle
  • 8 Core ERP Modules — Deep Dive
  • Unified Administration Dashboard
  • Smart Enrollment Management
  • Student Management & Records
  • Teacher Management
  • Class & Timetable Management
  • Attendance System
  • Fee Management System
  • Integrated Library Management
  • Transport Management
  • Parent Portal Access
  • Interactive Student Portal
  • Academic Configuration & Sessions
  • Arabic Language Support
  • Role-Based Access Matrix
  • Real-World Results
  • Who Benefits Most?
  • Client Success Stories
  • 5-Step Implementation
  • FAQs

Why Educational Institutions Outgrow Spreadsheets

Running a school, college, or training institute is no longer a clerical job. Between admission season, tuition invoicing, timetable reshuffles, bus route changes, parent calls, and library overdues, administrators juggle a dozen disconnected tools — Excel for fees, WhatsApp for parents, a paper ledger for library books, a notebook for transport routes. The result is predictable: lost records, delayed invoices, angry parents, and audit headaches at the end of every academic year.

We've seen this pattern repeatedly across institutions using school ERP software Egypt, the GCC, and beyond. The Odoo Education Management System, implemented by E-TripleSoft on your Odoo Enterprise database, solves this once and for all — a single application that runs every academic and administrative process end-to-end, with dedicated portals for Admins, Teachers, Students, and Parents, and full Arabic localization.

📋

Scattered Admissions

Paper enquiry forms, Excel trackers, and separate enrollment spreadsheets mean duplicate entry and lost applicants. The ERP runs Enquiry → Application → Verification → Enrollment as one continuous flow.

💰

Fee Chaos

Tuition, transport, library, and lunch fees live in different sheets. The integrated Fee Management generates grade-wise structures, invoices, and tracks overdues automatically in Odoo Accounting.

📞

Parent Communication Gaps

Parents call the office for every grade, fee, or absence. The Parent Portal gives them 24/7 self-service — view grades, pay fees, check attendance, switch between siblings.

🔒

Siloed Records

Student history, library borrows, transport route, fee receipts — all in separate systems. Odoo links every record to one student profile, auditable from admission to graduation.

What Is the Odoo Education Management System?

The Odoo Education Management System is a comprehensive, all-in-one education ERP software that runs natively on Odoo Enterprise — compatible across current Odoo versions. Unlike fragmented point solutions that bolt together a student database with a separate fee module and another for library, the Odoo school management system provides a single, unified ERP where every student record, every invoice, every library issue, and every bus route is linked through one database.

The module delivers four distinct role-based experiences from the same installation: an all-powerful Administration Dashboard, a productivity-focused Teacher Portal, an engaging Student Portal, and a transparent Parent Portal. Every stakeholder sees exactly what they need — nothing more, nothing less — and the entire system communicates through Odoo's native chatter, calendar, and notification engine.

⚡ One Database. Four Portals. Zero Duplication.

From the first admission enquiry to the final graduation transcript, every action lives in one Odoo database. Parents pay fees that instantly post to Odoo Accounting. Teachers mark attendance that instantly appears in the parent portal. Librarians issue a book that automatically links to the student profile. There is no import, no export, no reconciliation.

The Admission-to-Graduation Lifecycle — End to End

The Odoo school management system tracks every student from the first enquiry through enrollment, academic progression, and final graduation — all within a single database that your entire institution shares.

Every module of the ERP is designed around one continuous academic journey. A single enquiry becomes an application, becomes an enrollment, generates a fee structure, assigns a timetable, tracks attendance and grades, and ultimately produces an academic transcript — all inside the same system, with every relationship explicit and auditable.

01 Admission EnquiryWebsite form → CRM

Prospective families submit the admission enquiry form from the school website or at the front desk. The ERP captures applicant details, guardian contacts, prior school, and grade sought. Every enquiry becomes a traceable record, not a forgotten paper form.

02 Application & VerificationDocument review

Admissions staff verify birth certificates, transfer letters, and medical records against configurable application fields. The application status moves through Submitted → Under Review → Verified → Approved, with every decision stamped against a user and a date.

03 Enrollment & Class AllocationSession + grade assignment

Verified applicants are enrolled into a specific session (academic year), grade, and section. The system auto-generates the grade-specific fee structure, allocates the student to class sections, and provisions portal access for the student and their parents.

04 Fee Generation & CollectionInvoices + online payment

Tuition, transport, library, lunch, and registration fees are bundled into the student's invoice based on their grade and services. Parents pay online through the portal; payments reconcile to Odoo Accounting automatically with full receipt history.

05 Academic DeliveryTimetable, attendance & grades

Classes appear on the student, teacher, and parent calendars. Teachers mark attendance and grade assignments from their portal. Students submit assignments, track grades, and see attendance history in real time. Parents monitor everything from their portal.

06 Services & SupportLibrary + Transport + Scholarships

Library issues and returns, bus route assignments, scholarship applications, and disciplinary records all link back to the student's profile. Every service the student consumes is recorded against one unified record.

07 Transcripts & GraduationOne-click generation

At year-end or graduation, the system generates complete academic transcripts — grades, attendance, completed classes, personal details, and institution information — as downloadable PDFs. Alumni records stay in the database for future verifications.

See the Full Lifecycle in a Live Demo →

Deep Dive: 12 Core ERP Modules Built for Education

As a full-featured education ERP software, the Odoo Education Management System covers every operational layer of your institution — from the first student enquiry to the final transcript.

📊 Unified Administration Dashboard
